title: A Small Private Tour of the Alcazar and Cathedral in Seville
text: Vicky was a wonderful tour guide and extremely knowledgeable. It was a bit crowded on a warm day. Luckily, we have a small group and not overwhelming. The only recommendation is using the audio device during the tour can be helpful to hear the guide better.
author: D541AVjonathanl

title: Alcazar and Cathedral guided tour
text: Recommend the combo tour to take in both the Alcazar and the Cathedral. We were lucky to have José Maria as our guide, who was superb, so knowledgeable, informative and full of other advice for things to do and see in Seville.
author: Brian_M

title: Don’t miss!
text: The Alhambra is not to be missed!  Rich in history and beautiful architecture both  the Cathedral and Alcázar Palace were unforgettable.  Our guide was very good,  hard to understand a little bit but still awesome !!
author: Laurie_P

title: Hit with Ignacio!!
text: The explanation was very entertaining, informative and full of history. The guide was great, we were very happy with the tour and the recommendations to know more about Seville
author: DCamahuali

title: Best tour in Sevilla!
text: Adrian was the best tour guide!! He was informative and told wonderful stories about the cathedral and the Alcazar. This tour was definitely the highlight of our trip to Sevilla! Don’t miss climbing the bell tower. Otis not difficult and the views are worth it!
author: gailc688

title: Applause for Lupe:-)
text: The places alone are already impressive but touring them guided by Lupe is a luxury. His knowledge and Lupe’s love of history help you better understand events and appreciate every detail.
author: JorgelinaSC

title: Beautiful
text:
Sublime,
Beautiful, 
Breathtaking, 
One can only have eyes full of stars!
Seville is an extraordinary marble
author: Nono57190

title: Wonderful sites and fantastic guide
text: My wife and I booked the two tours in order to make best use of our time when visiting such historic buildings.  Our guide, Lupe, was fantastic.  Her English was excellent, many of her jokes were funny and she came across as very enthusiastic about what she was doing.  We really enjoyed both tours and would recommend the tour company and in particular we would recommend Lupe as a guide.
author: GDM_Sutton

title: Excellent Tour!
text: We loved our tours of the Cathedral and Alcazar while in Seville! Our tour guide Nacho was the BEST!! My son is a history major and truly appreciated Nacho’s knowledge and level of detail in each place we toured! I highly recommend this tour company and guide!
author: Qnrn
